acceptanceCriteria: A CHANGED_IN_DIFF outcome can be accepted only through a recorded, independent acceptance step.
Locator repair proposes a replacement locator with evidence and never auto-applies it; focused tests cover both.
body: Residual from lane cce-1022k (PR beamfall/corvint#1546, seal 1aa0691af). Outcomes whose oracle changed in the diff stay capped as oracle-self-certified (CCE-V0-016); there is no acceptance path for them and no locator repair when a changed selector breaks a compiled test.
title: CCE CHANGED_IN_DIFF acceptance and locator repair are not built
